bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears rode 38-year-old backup quarterback Case Keenum to a dominant Monday Night Football win, as Keenum shined while the Bears demolished the Eagles in Week 3 , improving Chicago to 2-1 on the season. The performance came with starter Caleb Williams sidelined by a hamstring injury suffered in Week 2, and while the Bears fell to 1-1 with a 9-3 loss to the Vikings that saw Williams go down , the team has since regrouped as key players like left tackle Ozzy Trapilo, defensive lineman Shemar Turner, and linebacker Noah Sewell progress toward returning to full practice .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions improved to 2-1 after a 31-24 comeback win over the New York Jets, with Jahmyr Gibbs carrying the ball 20 times for 99 yards and two touchdowns while catching seven of eight targets for 65 yards and a third TD , and Jared Goff completing 25 of 32 passes for 269 yards and two touchdowns . Meanwhile, trade buzz is heating up as the Detroit Lions have contacted the Pittsburgh Steelers about cornerback Joey Porter Jr., with several other NFL teams also competing for him .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers continued reinforcing their struggling offensive line by signing veteran OG Laken Tomlinson off the Cowboys' practice squad and adding Mekhi Becton ahead of their Week 4 matchup against Tampa Bay. Head coach Matt LaFleur also provided updates on the roster, addressing why star edge rusher Micah Parsons will not return to practice ahead of Week 4 and offering comments on the team's adjustment following Baker Mayfield's injury.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings traded quarterback J.J. McCarthy to the New York Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick after the Giants' Jaxson Dart suffered an injury, effectively ending Minnesota's turbulent experiment with the former first-round pick.
